body.title: Capture byte-identity goldens from real pre-fix records and convert the vacuous self-comparison
body.summary: Freeze the current rendered markdown of REAL pre-fix records as committed golden strings; a fixture constructed from the new understanding would agree with the fix by construction rather than by evidence. s1 confirmed the source exists: 63 BUILD records tracked, five with standalone true, and BUILD-1d3bd81c5560de0d-s1 and BUILD-dcbb529e465417af-s1 carrying exactly the pre-fix {focus, producesLld} body. Capture THREE goldens — a well-formed standalone, a plan-driven record, and the PATHOLOGICAL BUILD-be8708a9cd20e286-s1 (standalone true, sizeClass ABSENT, plan-driven {commit, tasks} body), without which the suite cannot catch the defect t8 must fix. In the SAME task, convert build-record.test.ts:142 from comparing the written md against renderStandaloneBuildRecordMd to comparing it against a frozen golden: once t8 makes that function a delegating shim, both sides of the current equality are the SAME function and it passes for any output. MUST precede t8 — a golden captured after records post-fix bytes.
acceptanceChecks: THREE real tracked BUILD record jsons are committed as fixtures with their CURRENT rendered markdown captured verbatim: a well-formed Trivial standalone, a plan-driven record, and BUILD-be8708a9cd20e286-s1 as the pathological case

The pathological golden's fixture comment states PLAINLY that it records a DEFECT rather than desired behaviour — its title contains the literal 'undefined' and its body.tasks render nowhere — so when t8 deliberately changes it the diff reads as a reviewed improvement, not an unexplained byte movement
The expectation is recorded explicitly: goldens 1 and 2 MUST NOT change at t8; golden 3 is the only one expected to change
build-record.test.ts:142 no longer calls renderStandaloneBuildRecordMd on the right-hand side; it compares the written md against the frozen golden

MUTATION PROOF, run and recorded: altering one heading in the renderer turns the converted test RED, while the same mutation against the pre-conversion assertion leaves it GREEN — demonstrating the conversion closed a real hole rather than restating a passing check
provenance-build.test.ts:105 is left untouched — it compares the renderer against itself on two DIFFERENT inputs (legacy vs base record), a legitimate equivalence check and not the vacuous pattern
All three goldens are captured on unmodified HEAD, before any renderer change lands

tests.name: BYTE-IDENTITY golden 1: a real pre-fix well-formed Trivial standalone record renders exactly its captured markdown
BYTE-IDENTITY golden 2: a real pre-fix plan-driven record renders exactly its captured markdown

BYTE-IDENTITY golden 3 (PATHOLOGICAL, expected to change at t8): BUILD-be8708a9cd20e286-s1 renders its captured markdown, 'undefined' title and absent tasks included — a recorded defect, not desired behaviour
CONVERTED from the vacuous self-comparison: persistBuildRecord's written md for a standalone record equals the FROZEN GOLDEN, not the renderer's own return value
MUTATION PROOF of the conversion: a one-heading change in the renderer turns the converted assertion RED, where the pre-conversion form stayed GREEN
a record written entirely before this change still parses, merges via mergeWithPrior and renders without error
